rationale: M37.21 #610 scala ScalaD-D (JD18 family lesson from java, probe-verified in scala): an anonymous class body (new Runnable { ... }) declares a Class symbol anonymous_Runnable owned by the enclosing type, and its methods attribute to the ANONYMOUS type (contains anonymous_Runnable->run), never to the enclosing class (the pre-fix bug leaked contains Service->run and fabricated no anonymous symbol).
